struct.name: SaveAupLocalOffset32
struct.math: 8x4B fields = 32; 32 mod 8 = 0. Local offsets are computed as absolute AUP minus sector origin before float cast.

struct.name: StateDeltaRecordDTO
struct.usage: delta record NativeArray and byte arena header
struct.math: 4x8B hash fields = 32; 8x4B fields = 32; total 64, one cache line. Disk/arena bytes are emitted and read by WriteStateDeltaRecordLittleEndian/ReadStateDeltaRecordLittleEndian.

struct.name: SaveMerkleWalAppendHeader
struct.math: 4x8B + 7x4B + 2x2B = 64. DateTime is no longer injected by default. Disk bytes are written/read by explicit little-endian helpers, not raw host struct copies.

struct.name: SaveMerkleEmergencyHeader64
struct.math: 5x8B + 5x4B + 2x2B = 64. GenerateEmergencyMockHeader writes explicit little-endian bytes and computes CRC over canonical bytes.

struct.name: Lz4SubBlockHeader
struct.math: Header is 32B; new RLE storage flag is bit 8; legacy bit 3 is accepted only on read. Disk bytes are emitted by WriteLz4SubBlockHeaderLittleEndian from the Burst compression job.

struct.name: CacheLineInt
struct.math: Explicit layout size 64 prevents adjacent counter false sharing.

scalability_curve.quality: SmoothUnit and math.step pull the system into survival band: sub-block size trends toward 12.5-25 percent of base, WAL bytes per second trends toward 12.5 percent retention, and cosmetic threshold collapses so LeafFlagCosmetic records are pruned before compression.
Critical inventory/base/player AUP stays; cosmetic payloads survive only when delta byte pressure is below the scaled threshold. RLE runs first to reduce MicroSD writes; LZ4 handles mixed entropy.
MathLod rises toward 3, larger sub-blocks improve compression ratio, and more cosmetic sectors remain in WAL because storage pressure is lower.
scalability_curve.implementation: ResolveRuntimeConfigForQuality uses math.lerp, math.step, SmoothUnit polynomial, and saturate. No binary low/high branch is used for quality.

buffer.note: Sequential job counters, not concurrent atomics.

pointer_aliasing_and_dependency_graph.rule: All SHINOBU_72 SaveSystem Burst jobs use FloatMode.Deterministic with FloatPrecision.Standard because persisted state is rollback-sensitive.
No arbitrary JobHandle.Complete() exists in SaveStateMerkleTree job scheduling.
Cold WAL replay consumes caller-owned NativeArray<byte> destination and compressed scratch buffers, rejects overlapping pointer ranges, and uses no managed byte[] staging.

Hecton8.Core.asmdef already references sibling runtime assemblies such as Animation.IK, Inventory, Environment.Fluids, World.Terrain, AI, Physics, Audio, Logistics, Cartography, and Input.
